import requests

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
API_KEY = "sk-user-079O8fhuwLfTUkvaaPDvknwXARNtNxQZQrgRjQbYAW-nVo6lVOSIqPp2C3Uc9chWmwWyMwSi7_fExy3ld4Pd9udy1lJeWJFcggCzzSJj9xjSo9NsVwNkooP9MwqVQUOv9tY"

HEADERS_TEMPLATE = {
    "Authorization": f"ApiKey {API_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "Accept": "application/json",
}

def testadminauthenticationrolebasedaccesscontrol():
    """
    Verify that the admin authentication system correctly enforces role-based access control for 
    SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, and EDITOR roles, restricting permissions appropriately in the admin panel.
    """
    # Assuming API endpoints for authentication and admin resource access:
    # POST /api/auth/login { email, password } -> returns token and role info
    # GET /api/admin/panel/resources - requires role-based access, should return info or 403 if no access
    
    # Test users and credentials with roles (dummy placeholders; adjust to real test users if available)
    users = {
        "SUPER_ADMIN": {"email": "superadminuser@example.com", "password": "superadminpass"},
        "ADMIN": {"email": "adminuser@example.com", "password": "adminpass"},
        "EDITOR": {"email": "editoruser@example.com", "password": "editorpass"},
    }
    
    def login(email, password):
        url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/auth/login"
        payload = {"email": email, "password": password}
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"}
        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data = resp.json()
        # Expect token and role in response
        assert "token" in data, "Login response missing token"
        assert "role" in data, "Login response missing role"
        return data["token"], data["role"]

    def access_admin_resource(token):
        url = f"{BASE_URL}/api/admin/panel/resources"
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",
            "Accept": "application/json",
        }
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
        return resp

    # Role-based expected access permissions:
    # SUPER_ADMIN: full access (expect 200)
    # ADMIN: limited access (expect 200 or restricted data)
    # EDITOR: restricted access (expect 403 or restricted data)
    
    role_access_expectations = {
        "SUPER_ADMIN": 200,
        "ADMIN": 200,
        "EDITOR": 403,
    }
    
    for role, creds in users.items():
        try:
            token, returned_role = login(creds["email"], creds["password"])
        except requests.HTTPError as e:
            assert False, f"Login failed for role {role}: {e}"
        
        # Confirm returned role matches expected
        assert returned_role == role, f"Role mismatch: expected {role}, got {returned_role}"

        resp = access_admin_resource(token)
        expected_status = role_access_expectations[role]
        assert resp.status_code == expected_status, (
            f"Access control failed for role {role}: expected HTTP {expected_status}, got {resp.status_code}"
        )
        if resp.status_code == 200:
            # Validate essential data keys exist in response JSON if applicable
            json_data = resp.json()
            assert isinstance(json_data, dict), "Admin resource response is not a JSON object"
            # Additional checks can be added here if needed for resources
        else:
            # For 403 Forbidden, check message or details if provided
            if resp.status_code == 403:
                try:
                    error_data = resp.json()
                    assert "error" in error_data or "message" in error_data, "No error message in 403 response"
                except Exception:
                    pass

title: TC002-testpackagescrudoperations
description: Test the CRUD operations for road assistance packages via the packages API endpoints, ensuring admins can create, edit, delete packages and public users can view and purchase packages.

import requests

BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
API_KEY = "sk-user-079O8fhuwLfTUkvaaPDvknwXARNtNxQZQrgRjQbYAW-nVo6lVOSIqPp2C3Uc9chWmwWyMwSi7_fExy3ld4Pd9udy1lJeWJFcggCzzSJj9xjSo9NsVwNkooP9MwqVQUOv9tY"

HEADERS_ADMIN = {
    "Authorization": f"Bearer {API_KEY}",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

HEADERS_PUBLIC = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}


def testpackagescrudoperations():
    timeout = 30
    package_id = None
    try:
        # ===== Admin creates a new package =====
        create_payload = {
            "name": "Premium Road Assistance",
            "description": "24/7 towing and locksmith services with battery support",
            "price": 199.99,
            "duration_days": 365,
            "features": [
                "Towing",
                "Battery Support",
                "Locksmith"
            ],
            "availability": True
        }
        create_resp = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/packages",
            headers=HEADERS_ADMIN,
            json=create_payload,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        assert create_resp.status_code == 201, f"Create package failed: {create_resp.text}"
        created_package = create_resp.json()
        for key in create_payload:
            assert created_package.get(key) == create_payload[key], f"Mismatch in created package field: {key}"
        package_id = created_package.get("id")
        assert package_id is not None, "Created package ID is None"

        # ===== Admin edits the created package =====
        update_payload = {
            "name": "Premium Road Assistance Plus",
            "price": 249.99,
            "availability": False,
            "features": [
                "Towing",
                "Battery Support",
                "Locksmith",
                "Fuel Delivery"
            ],
        }
        update_resp = requests.put(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/packages/{package_id}",
            headers=HEADERS_ADMIN,
            json=update_payload,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        assert update_resp.status_code == 200, f"Update package failed: {update_resp.text}"
        updated_package = update_resp.json()
        for key in update_payload:
            assert updated_package.get(key) == update_payload[key], f"Mismatch in updated package field: {key}"

        # ===== Public user views the list of packages =====
        list_resp = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/packages",
            headers=HEADERS_PUBLIC,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        assert list_resp.status_code == 200, f"List packages failed: {list_resp.text}"
        packages_list = list_resp.json()
        assert isinstance(packages_list, list), "Packages list response is not a list"
        assert any(pkg.get("id") == package_id for pkg in packages_list), "Created package not found in packages list"

        # ===== Public user views a single package detail =====
        detail_resp = requests.get(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/packages/{package_id}",
            headers=HEADERS_PUBLIC,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        assert detail_resp.status_code == 200, f"Get package detail failed: {detail_resp.text}"
        package_detail = detail_resp.json()
        assert package_detail.get("id") == package_id, "Mismatch in package detail id"

        # ===== Public user purchases the package via application submission =====
        # Simulating purchase as public user submitting an application
        purchase_payload = {
            "package_id": package_id,
            "user_name": "John Doe",
            "user_contact": "john.doe@example.com",
            "vehicle_plate": "ABC1234",
            "national_id": "1234567890",
            "location": {"lat": 40.7128, "lng": -74.0060},
            "problem_type": "Breakdown"
        }
        purchase_resp = requests.post(
            f"{BASE_URL}/api/applications",
            headers=HEADERS_PUBLIC,
            json=purchase_payload,
            timeout=timeout,
        )
        assert purchase_resp.status_code == 201, f"Package purchase (application submission) failed: {purchase_resp.text}"
        purchase_result = purchase_resp.json()
        assert purchase_result.get("package_id") == package_id, "Purchased application package_id mismatch"
        assert purchase_result.get("user_name") == purchase_payload["user_name"], "Purchased application user_name mismatch"

    finally:
        # Cleanup: Admin deletes the created package
        if package_id:
            del_resp = requests.delete(
                f"{BASE_URL}/api/packages/{package_id}",
                headers=HEADERS_ADMIN,
                timeout=timeout,
            )
            assert del_resp.status_code in [200, 204], f"Delete package failed: {del_resp.text}"

        "nationalId": "12345678901",
